name: Tab Janitor
tagline: Clears the abandoned tabs out of a shared cloud browser
description: A shared browser session collects debris fast. This bot takes stock of everything currently open, proposes a cleanup without touching a thing on the first pass, respects a list of tabs the owner has marked untouchable, and shuts only what is plainly finished with. Then it reports what it did.
author: SuddenlyJon
notes: Native Grok Bot share. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
